pages.notes: Actual contents page inspected: ten topics from HRI introduction through summary; no distinct worked fact/code/formula; footer2.

Full text and annotated humanoid photograph inspected. Definition/interdisciplinary HRI; verbal speech, nonverbal expression/gesture/gaze/proximity, physical touch/manipulation. Torso camera circled and labeled Intel RealSense D435i for nonverbal; speaker icon. Trust calibration requires contextual/social appropriateness, not maximum trust. General benefit claims are goals, not measured causal results. Footer3.

Actual multimodal bullets and speech-plus-camera graphic inspected. Modality defined; early/late/hybrid-intermediate fusion named but not formalized. This system converts visual output to natural-language description; language-mediated fusion generalizes to textual structured signals. Blanket robustness/accuracy statements require conditions; text conversion can discard information and poor/late inputs can harm decisions. Footer4.

Actual layered diagram inspected. Left RGB-D→face detection→DeepFace→seven categories happy/sad/angry/surprise/neutral/fear/disgust. Right microphone→OpenAI API→response generation→speaker. Context box explicitly says emotion integrated BEFORE response generation despite schematic downward arrows. Six middleware nodes camera,face detection,emotion,conversation,audio I/O,visualization. Hardware camera,Jetson,USB microphone,speaker,screen. Footer5.

Actual front/back annotated robot photos inspected. Screen torso visualization, speaker chest, D435i RGB+depth, DJI microphone/receiver USB speech input, Jetson Orin Nano onboard GPU, power cables supply compute/display. Source uses Nano/Orin Nano loosely in callouts; do not infer exact board SKU/specification from photo. Local perception does not make external conversational API offline; latency is not guaranteed by GPU alone. Footer6.

Actual software stack and all bullets inspected: Ubuntu22.04 OS→ROS2 Humble middleware→OpenCV/DeepFace perception and OpenAI API voice→application. Python integration; WebSockets bidirectional audio. Diagram arrows show architecture, not a claim all raw images go to cloud or a full executable program. Footer7.

Actual two diagrams inspected. Vertical camera→face detection→face cropping→DeepFace→emotion label→ROS2 topic. Bottom repeats RGB-D/detection/DeepFace/seven categories, with typo Netural. Detection is ROI localization; expression classification is later. RGB-D source does not prove depth is passed to the expression network. Footer8.

Actual heading Face Detection Pipeline but bullets include expression-network resizing, normalization, convolution features, abstract features, Softmax, argmax and confidence filtering. Right diagram itself ends at face crop. Lower live-view screenshot shows face box and text overlays; tiny numerical labels need enlarged revisit before use. Distinguish detection from emotion classification; no specific input resolution or threshold value supplied. Footer9. Enlarged original PDF screenshot revisited: green ROI, Neutral label and speech/robot transcript overlays; top and bottom FPS fields differ, so no stable FPS benchmark inferred. Tiny partially clipped transcript not used for exact quotation.

Actual DeepFace bullets and face-crop→DeepFace→feature-extraction→emotion-classification diagram inspected. Seven categories explicitly listed. Pretrained inference is not online training. Screenshot has log, green box and neutral label; precise score requires crop revisit. Confidence as reliability is not a calibrated correctness probability or proof of inner emotion. Footer10. Enlarged original PDF screenshot revisited: highlighted Emotion: Neutral (94%); upper live-view FPS30.5; console shows alternating Neutral/Angry detections, Speech detected and Processing. These are saved displayed predictions, not validation labels or a measured94% accuracy.

Actual text and microphone→API→response→speaker diagram inspected. Spoken interaction combines speech understanding, reasoning, generation; multiturm context; low latency; emotion adapts tone/style. Contextual visual cue does not override explicit user request; usage domains are examples not clinical effectiveness proof. Footer11.

Actual Realtime architecture bullets and vertical diagram inspected: WebSocket session→audio input→speech understanding→conversation context→reasoning→synthesis→streaming output. Persistent bidirectional event-driven stream; incremental audio not whole recording. Session not unlimited history. Interruption handling depends on client/configuration; WebSocket is chosen transport, not only possible API transport. This is conceptual, not mandatory explicit STT→text→TTS internal implementation. Footer12.

Actual event-driven prose and right sequence inspected: session created→audio buffer append→VAD→speech transcription→conversation context→language model→speech synthesis→audio→session continues. VAD locates speech boundaries, not intent. Full duplex sends/receives concurrently. Independent events does not mean unordered/statistically independent state. Transcript generation/configuration and interruption are implementation-dependent; no exact API event names or source code printed. Footer13.

Actual streaming bullets and screenshot inspected: microphone digital samples, sequential buffers, persistent connection, incremental playback. Screenshot shows Neutral(88%) and speech/robot transcript overlays, topFPS28.9, bottomFPSdifferent; not timing benchmark. Buffering absorbs bounded jitter but cannot guarantee uninterrupted output for arbitrary network outage. Interruption cannot literally be zero-time or automatically flush every client queue without handling. Footer14.

Actual torso-screen→desktop screenshot and monitoring bullets inspected. Overlays expose boxes,labels,confidence; topic monitoring tests communication; logs expose failures; recordings support retrospective analysis. Visualization and node graph not proof of prediction correctness, freshness or ground-truth accuracy. Footer15.

Actual vision→emotion→text context→RealtimeAPI→emotion-aware response diagram and bullets inspected. Visual result is structured text, not necessarily direct raw image input to LLM. Perception/dialogue independent modules with information exchange. Text-only representation can lose confidence/timing unless carried. Facial label is a model-estimated expression cue, not established inner state. Footer16.

Actual prompt bullets and four-box emotion label→prompt context→LLM→response inspected. Static personality/behavior/objectives versus dynamic estimated emotion. Spoken intent prioritized; deduplicate emotion updates to avoid history growth; prompting does not update model weights. No exact API calls/dedup algorithm/threshold printed; any trace must label supplied policy. Footer17.

Actual full data-flow arrows traced: Human splits facial→RealSense→Face→DeepFaceEmotion→Emotion and speech→Microphone→Audio; both feed Context; then rightmost down to OpenAIRealtime; bottom flows RIGHT TO LEFT Speech→Language→Speech→Robot→Human. This is conceptual functional flow, not proof API internally requires separate transcripts. Bullets say parallel modalities and contextual integration before streamed response. Footer18.

Actual rqt_graph inspected: five oval nodes /camera_node,/face_detection_node,/emotion_node,/tara_node,/visualization_node. /camera_node publishes /camera/depth/image_rect_raw and /camera/color/image_raw; both feed face detection; color also feeds emotion. Detector publishes /human_face and /human_face/annotated; human_face feeds emotion; annotated feeds visualization. Emotion→/human_emotion→tara and visualization. Tara→/chatgpt_response and /speech_text→visualization. Nested rectangles are namespaces/topics, not extra processing nodes. Prose: pub/sub, asynchronous, QoS, launch parameters, modularity. Message passing removes direct calls but not topic/type/QoS/semantic contracts; independent ROS nodes need not be separate OS processes. Footer19.

Actual execution sequence and all bullets inspected: unified launch initializes nodes; camera/detection/DeepFace/emotiontopic/API/speaker. Microphone captured concurrently; emotion before response. Concurrency does not synchronize timestamps or guarantee deadlines. The launch-file box is not provided source code. Footer20.

Actual demonstration photo inspected. Person seated facing humanoid with an extended arm, chest display, torso camera and wheeled base. Caption inside photo reads Detects Human emotion and greets accordingly; [1] references robot design. Static image demonstrates setup/claimed behavior, not measured accuracy, latency, autonomous navigation or safety. No video execution or hidden audio inferred. Footer21.

Actual engineering bullets inspected: USB shared bandwidth, dependencies, embedded drivers, asynchronous synchronization, cloud network, resource optimization, modular maintenance. No throughput, timing or exact versions beyond earlier OS/ROS supplied here; all numeric examples must explicitly stipulate values. Distinguish camera USB bottleneck from cloud latency and inference compute. Footer22.

Actual applications bullets inspected: healthcare personalized assistance; education engagement/confusion/frustration; service/hospitality; elderly companion communication; industrial operator attention/emotion; reception/info at hospitals/airports/public facilities; research. These are proposed domains, not proof seven-way expression classifier directly measures confusion/attention or provides diagnosis. Footer23.
